title: Current availability and how to book
body: I train Monday-Thursday 7-8am and 3:30-5:30pm, and Friday-Saturday 7am-5:30pm, in Colorado Springs, Fountain, Pueblo, Hanover, Woodland Park, Falcon, Ellicott, Yoder, Calhan, and surrounding areas. Free video/phone consults are available too. New clients start with an In-Home Consult. To book, text or call 406-533-5127 or email training@k9-communication.com and I'll confirm a time.
